text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Police Certificate Police Certificate (non-school students shall provide Police Certificate. The certificate should be less than six months old, if valid date is unspecified; If the validity period is indicated, the materials shall prevail; Students enrolled shall provide a proof of school/university performance instead). * 2. Personal bank statement as evidence of financial support ($5,000 USD above, evidence of relationship must be provided in the case of parents being sponsors). * 3. English language proficiency certificate * 4. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (by the admission, the certificate must be less than six months old). * 5. Passport copies (photograph page), passport is not renewable from the time of application to the entry to China with a valid visa. * 6. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 7. Copies of high school transcripts (non-Chinese or English versions must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations). * 8. Student Identity Certification or graduation certificate copies (non-Chinese or English versions must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations). 9. Letter of recommendation from two teachers * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
